summary: Ingredion Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion of the sale of 51% of Rafhan Maize Products Co. Ltd. to Nishat Hotels and Properties Limited and affiliates (Nishat Group). Aggregate cash consideration was ~$165 million. The purchaser also bought additional shares from other holders, acquiring ~78% of Rafhan. Ingredion retains a ~20% minority interest with a put option exercisable beginning in the fifth year post-closing. Ingredion’s net sales from Rafhan were ~$250 million in 2025. The board recommended the transaction; no advisor named. The deal closed on June 30, 2026. Watch for integration under Nishat Group and the future exercise of Ingredion’s put option.
